p=Path('/tmp/tomlkit_conversion_repro.py')
p.write_text('''import tomlkit
from tomlkit import to_inline_table, to_standard_table, to_dotted_keys, to_super_table
d = tomlkit.parse("[a] # header\nx = 1\n[a.b]\ny = 2\n")
original = d.unwrap()
for f in (to_inline_table, to_standard_table, to_dotted_keys, to_super_table):
    assert f("a", d) is d
    assert tomlkit.parse(tomlkit.dumps(d)).unwrap() == original
print("conversion round trip passed")
''')
